# Rule catalog

Every data quality rule of the pipeline, generated from the dbt YAML. Rules with severity `error` stop the pipeline at their layer: the batch never reaches the domain's gold schema. Structural bronze rules come from the data contracts; silver and gold rules are the business rules and each has its own page.

| Domain | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ecommerce](ecommerce/README.md) | 19 | 21 | 5 | 45 |
| [fintech](fintech/README.md) | 11 | 18 | 5 | 34 |
| [streaming](streaming/README.md) | 16 | 16 | 5 | 37 |
| **Total** | 46 | 55 | 15 | **116** |

## ecommerce

| Rule | Layer | What it guarantees |
|---|---|---|
| [`ecommerce_sales_grain_unique`](ecommerce/ecommerce_sales_grain_unique.md) | gold | One row per day and category; duplicates would double-count revenue in reports. |
| [`ecommerce_sales_net_not_above_gross`](ecommerce/ecommerce_sales_net_not_above_gross.md) | gold | Net revenue (after discounts) can never be negative or exceed gross revenue. |
| [`ecommerce_gold_revenue_reconciles`](ecommerce/ecommerce_gold_revenue_reconciles.md) | gold | Gold revenue matches the silver orders it was built from. |
| [`ecommerce_daily_kpis_not_empty`](ecommerce/ecommerce_daily_kpis_not_empty.md) | gold | A published day must contain at least one valid order; an empty KPI table means everything was filtered out upstream. |
| [`ecommerce_daily_aov_within_bounds`](ecommerce/ecommerce_daily_aov_within_bounds.md) | gold | A daily average order value above 5,000 has never been a real business day — it signals a pricing/quantity bug or bulk fraud, even if every row looks valid. |
| [`ecommerce_customer_id_unique`](ecommerce/ecommerce_customer_id_unique.md) | silver | A customer appears once per snapshot; duplicates would split order history and lifetime value. |
| [`ecommerce_customer_email_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_customer_email_valid.md) | silver | Transactional email (receipts, shipping) needs a deliverable address. |
| [`ecommerce_customer_country_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_customer_country_valid.md) | silver | Customers can only register in the markets the store operates in. |
| [`ecommerce_customer_signup_not_in_future`](ecommerce/ecommerce_customer_signup_not_in_future.md) | silver | A signup date in the future signals a timezone or parsing bug upstream. |
| [`ecommerce_product_sku_unique`](ecommerce/ecommerce_product_sku_unique.md) | silver | The SKU identifies a product; two catalog rows for one SKU make its price and category ambiguous. |
| [`ecommerce_product_price_positive`](ecommerce/ecommerce_product_price_positive.md) | silver | Catalog prices are positive; giveaways are modelled as discounts, not as zero prices. |
| [`ecommerce_product_category_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_product_category_valid.md) | silver | Every product belongs to a known category, so category reports add up to the total. |
| [`ecommerce_item_line_unique`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_line_unique.md) | silver | An order line is identified by order and line number; duplicates would double-count units and revenue. |
| [`ecommerce_item_discount_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_discount_valid.md) | silver | A discount can't be negative or larger than the line amount. |
| [`ecommerce_item_product_active`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_product_active.md) | silver | Discontinued products can't be sold. |
| [`ecommerce_item_order_exists`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_order_exists.md) | silver | Order lines must belong to an order of the same batch (no orphan lines). |
| [`ecommerce_item_product_exists`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_product_exists.md) | silver | Every line sells a product of the catalog; unknown SKUs can't be priced or categorised. |
| [`ecommerce_item_quantity_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_quantity_valid.md) | silver | Between 1 and 1,000 units per line (B2B orders go through another channel). |
| [`ecommerce_item_price_positive`](ecommerce/ecommerce_item_price_positive.md) | silver | The price charged per unit must be positive. |
| [`ecommerce_order_total_matches_items`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_total_matches_items.md) | silver | The charged total equals the sum of its lines (net of discounts), to the cent. |
| [`ecommerce_order_has_items`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_has_items.md) | silver | An order without lines has nothing to fulfil or charge, which usually means a partial export. |
| [`ecommerce_order_id_unique`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_id_unique.md) | silver | Same order id with different content means a conflicting replay (exact replays are deduplicated). |
| [`ecommerce_order_customer_exists`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_customer_exists.md) | silver | Orders must be placed by a known customer. |
| [`ecommerce_order_status_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_status_valid.md) | silver | The status must be a step of the order lifecycle: placed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled or refunded. |
| [`ecommerce_order_shipping_country_valid`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_shipping_country_valid.md) | silver | Orders only ship to countries the store delivers to. |
| [`ecommerce_order_not_in_future`](ecommerce/ecommerce_order_not_in_future.md) | silver | Orders can't be placed in the future. |

## fintech

| Rule | Layer | What it guarantees |
|---|---|---|
| [`fintech_position_grain_unique`](fintech/fintech_position_grain_unique.md) | gold | One position per account and day; duplicates would double-count balances. |
| [`fintech_no_overdraft_beyond_credit_limit`](fintech/fintech_no_overdraft_beyond_credit_limit.md) | gold | No account may end the day with a net outflow larger than its credit limit. |
| [`fintech_gold_reconciles_with_silver`](fintech/fintech_gold_reconciles_with_silver.md) | gold | Every posted cent in silver is accounted for in gold. |
| [`fintech_daily_summary_not_empty`](fintech/fintech_daily_summary_not_empty.md) | gold | A published day must contain at least one posted movement. |
| [`fintech_summary_flows_consistent`](fintech/fintech_summary_flows_consistent.md) | gold | Inflows and outflows are non-negative and the net flow equals inflows minus outflows. |
| [`fintech_account_currency_matches_country`](fintech/fintech_account_currency_matches_country.md) | silver | Accounts are opened in the local currency of their country. |
| [`fintech_account_id_unique`](fintech/fintech_account_id_unique.md) | silver | An account appears once per snapshot. |
| [`fintech_account_status_valid`](fintech/fintech_account_status_valid.md) | silver | Accounts are active, frozen or closed: the states the core banking system knows. |
| [`fintech_credit_limit_within_policy`](fintech/fintech_credit_limit_within_policy.md) | silver | Credit lines go from 0 to 100,000. |
| [`fintech_account_opened_not_in_future`](fintech/fintech_account_opened_not_in_future.md) | silver | An account can't be opened in the future. |
| [`fintech_txn_currency_matches_account`](fintech/fintech_txn_currency_matches_account.md) | silver | A transaction is always booked in its account's currency (no implicit FX). |
| [`fintech_card_payment_has_merchant`](fintech/fintech_card_payment_has_merchant.md) | silver | Card payments must carry a merchant category code (MCC) for AML screening. |
| [`fintech_posted_only_on_active_accounts`](fintech/fintech_posted_only_on_active_accounts.md) | silver | Frozen and closed accounts cannot have posted movements. |
| [`fintech_txn_amount_two_decimals`](fintech/fintech_txn_amount_two_decimals.md) | silver | Amounts are expressed in cents; sub-cent precision indicates a broken upstream conversion. |
| [`fintech_txn_id_unique`](fintech/fintech_txn_id_unique.md) | silver | Same id with different content means a conflicting replay (exact replays are deduplicated). |
| [`fintech_txn_account_exists`](fintech/fintech_txn_account_exists.md) | silver | Every transaction belongs to a known account; orphan movements can't be reconciled. |
| [`fintech_txn_amount_positive`](fintech/fintech_txn_amount_positive.md) | silver | Amounts are positive; direction comes from txn_type. |
| [`fintech_txn_amount_below_single_limit`](fintech/fintech_txn_amount_below_single_limit.md) | silver | Single movements above 10,000 require manual approval and never arrive in this feed. |
| [`fintech_txn_high_value_review`](fintech/fintech_txn_high_value_review.md) | silver | Movements above 5,000 are reported for review but do not stop the pipeline. |
| [`fintech_txn_currency_supported`](fintech/fintech_txn_currency_supported.md) | silver | Only the ISO 4217 currencies the bank operates in are accepted. |
| [`fintech_txn_type_valid`](fintech/fintech_txn_type_valid.md) | silver | The transaction type gives its direction (credit or debit); an unknown type can't be signed. |
| [`fintech_txn_status_valid`](fintech/fintech_txn_status_valid.md) | silver | Transactions are posted, pending or reversed; only posted ones move balances. |
| [`fintech_txn_not_in_future`](fintech/fintech_txn_not_in_future.md) | silver | Movements can't be booked in the future (5 minutes of tolerance for clock skew). |

## streaming

| Rule | Layer | What it guarantees |
|---|---|---|
| [`streaming_engagement_grain_unique`](streaming/streaming_engagement_grain_unique.md) | gold | One row per day and content item. |
| [`streaming_gold_watch_time_reconciles`](streaming/streaming_gold_watch_time_reconciles.md) | gold | Watch hours in gold add up to the watch seconds in silver. |
| [`streaming_completion_rate_valid`](streaming/streaming_completion_rate_valid.md) | gold | The completion rate is completions over plays, so it must be between 0 and 1. |
| [`streaming_user_activity_grain_unique`](streaming/streaming_user_activity_grain_unique.md) | gold | One row per user and day. |
| [`streaming_user_daily_watch_time_possible`](streaming/streaming_user_daily_watch_time_possible.md) | gold | Nobody watches more than 24 hours in a day — shared or bot accounts, or duplicated events. |
| [`streaming_user_id_unique`](streaming/streaming_user_id_unique.md) | silver | A subscriber appears once per snapshot. |
| [`streaming_user_plan_valid`](streaming/streaming_user_plan_valid.md) | silver | Plans are free, basic or premium; entitlements depend on the plan. |
| [`streaming_content_id_unique`](streaming/streaming_content_id_unique.md) | silver | A content item appears once in the catalog. |
| [`streaming_content_type_valid`](streaming/streaming_content_type_valid.md) | silver | Content is a movie, an episode, a music track or a podcast. |
| [`streaming_content_duration_valid`](streaming/streaming_content_duration_valid.md) | silver | Content lasts between 1 second and 6 hours. |
| [`streaming_event_position_within_duration`](streaming/streaming_event_position_within_duration.md) | silver | The playhead can't be before the start or past the end of the content. |
| [`streaming_event_watch_seconds_valid`](streaming/streaming_event_watch_seconds_valid.md) | silver | Time watched since the previous event is non-negative and bounded by the content length. |
| [`streaming_completion_requires_90_percent`](streaming/streaming_completion_requires_90_percent.md) | silver | A play only counts as complete (royalties, recommendations) after 90% of the content. |
| [`streaming_free_plan_not_on_tv`](streaming/streaming_free_plan_not_on_tv.md) | silver | Entitlement: TV apps are for paid plans only. |
| [`streaming_event_after_signup`](streaming/streaming_event_after_signup.md) | silver | A user can't play content before signing up; this points to wrong user ids or clock issues. |
| [`streaming_event_id_unique`](streaming/streaming_event_id_unique.md) | silver | Same event id with different content means a conflicting replay (exact replays are deduplicated). |
| [`streaming_event_user_exists`](streaming/streaming_event_user_exists.md) | silver | Every playback event belongs to a known subscriber. |
| [`streaming_event_content_exists`](streaming/streaming_event_content_exists.md) | silver | Every playback event refers to catalog content (royalties are paid per content item). |
| [`streaming_event_type_valid`](streaming/streaming_event_type_valid.md) | silver | Player events are start, pause, resume, stop or complete. |
| [`streaming_event_device_valid`](streaming/streaming_event_device_valid.md) | silver | Playback only happens on supported devices: tv, mobile, web or tablet. |
| [`streaming_event_not_in_future`](streaming/streaming_event_not_in_future.md) | silver | Events can't happen in the future. |

## Adding or changing a rule

Edit the rule in `dbt/models/<domain>/<layer>/_<layer>.yml` (give it a `name` and a `description`), then regenerate these pages with `python -m pipeline docs`. CI fails if they are out of date.
